note: Lines the hero speaks at milestones. Placeholders {name} (the thing just met) and {n} (the level) only. Each kind needs 6 or more any lines; classes adds flavour for one class (keys must be in classes). The choice is seeded by profile, kind and key, so a replay says the same line. No line may name content the hero has not met.
